title: Sphynx lesson
description: A lesson: lesson.json plus lesson.md (and lesson.<lang>.md for translations) in one folder. See docs/creating-challenges.md#lessons.

topic.description: The unit key this lesson belongs to (from a subject.json), e.g. "NumberSystems".

minutes.description: Reading time. Defaults to an estimate from the text.

requires.description: Units the student should know first, by unit key (for example "Loops" from Java Programming). Shown with the student's progress in each unit; never enforced.

subject.description: The subject (for example "cs"), for content without a unit. Otherwise the unit decides the subject.

translations.description: By language, e.g. { "pt-br": { "title": "…" } }. The text goes in lesson.<lang>.md.
